asr.full_text: The Cryptocurrency of 2019 60 days has passed and over 50,000 miners in over 183 countries worldwide. History is about to repeat itself. Welcome to the future of cryptocurrency Since 2009 a new era has begun in the financial world Satoshi Nakamoto invents the 1st cryptocurrency Bitcoin Since then, digital money has never been the same Bitcoin rises in value with more than a 1000% Global inflation strikes. Economic meltdown and inflation are our biggest enemies. One USD today will not be worth the same as one USD tomorrow. The value of traditional currencies declines. The future money lies in cryptocurrency. The biggest innovations and companies that changed our lives overnight are internet-based companies that build new global communities online. Apple, Google, Facebook. Cryptocurrency is the future of money transactions online. The timing could not be better. Bitcoin shows us the way, but the best is still to come. A new, innovative crypto- coin is introduced into the market. Based on the success of Bitcoin, but better, smarter and more innovative. We are introducing 1-Coin to the market. Already expanding into a worldwide mining network and creating history again in the cryptocurrency industry. 1-Coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market. One Coin has a powerful founder with a strong vision. Dr. Rooja Ignatola is a financial and legal expert, well-known in financial circles, with excellent education and experience in banking and finance. One of the few who will not position in the financial sector. She is passionate about the future of virtual currency. Always striving to be on top of the game and dedicated to achieve her ambitious goal to make OneCoin one of the world leading currencies.

textual.context: Promotional context is supported by the description and ASR; the records do not establish whether registration produces any particular outcome.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated success-oriented financial proposition is connected to a request to complete free registration at a specified signup destination.
textual.limitations: The records do not show the signup page, its terms, any payment or data fields, whether registration was completed, or any actual financial result.

visual.observation: Chinese on-screen text states that after 60 days, 50,000 miners from 183 countries had been attracted; the frame shows a posed group of business-attired people before a world map.
visual.context: The sample presents the statement as promotional-style narration; no requested viewer action is visible.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated global recruitment scale is linked to mining participation, which may conditionally merit review if the broader video connects recruitment to payment, transfers, or promised returns.
visual.limitations: This frame does not show a contact method, payment or transfer step, enrollment process, or outcome.

visual.observation: Chinese on-screen text states that Bitcoin increased in value by more than 1000% and became a successful and creative asset of the era.
visual.context: The claim appears in a cryptocurrency-focused presentation, with an upward arrow graphic; no action directed at viewers is visible.
visual.potential_relevance: A specific cryptocurrency appreciation claim is shown, but these frames do not connect it to an audience investment, payment, or transfer request.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish the time period, basis, accuracy, or that viewers are being offered an investment.

visual.observation: Chinese on-screen text says that a new cryptocurrency was introduced to the market and that it expanded into a global mining network; the image depicts cryptocurrency-mining hardware.
visual.context: The samples present descriptive/promotional claims about a cryptocurrency and mining network; promotion versus discussion is unclear from the visible frames alone.
visual.potential_relevance: The claimed introduction of a cryptocurrency is paired with a claimed global mining network, which may conditionally merit review if other material links participation to recruitment, transfers, or returns.
visual.limitations: No currency name, acquisition method, payment destination, participation instructions, or returns claim is visible.

visual.observation: Chinese on-screen text identifies a purported founder as Dr. Roger Igor Novikov and describes him as one of a small number of senior financial figures; framed documents are shown, though their contents are not legible.
visual.context: The video presents an apparent identity and professional-status claim alongside unreadable framed documents and a coin graphic.
visual.potential_relevance: The claimed founder identity and financial-sector status are used in proximity to the cryptocurrency presentation, which may conditionally merit review if the wider source ties this claimed authority to a viewer action or destination.
visual.limitations: The frames do not verify the person's identity, credentials, relationship to the cryptocurrency, document contents, or any endorsement.

annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content promotes a specific cryptocurrency, OneCoin, and links its presentation to success-oriented messaging and a registration pathway. The supplied evidence supports promotion of the token/currency and an anticipated future market role, but does not establish an actual purchase, presale, dividend, or completed investment.
